description: Start here. One bounded summary of the signed-in person: their wardrobe in numbers (garments per class, main colours, materials, formality) with the garments they use most, their written style profile, what the wardrobe is missing, their usual sizes, what they have recently worn, liked or rejected, and what they want. detail='summary' (default, under 2,500 tokens) is enough for most conversations; 'full' (under 8,000) adds the evidence behind each profile line and more garments. Use the garment ids with get_item. Call it once per conversation, not per message.
name: get_context

outputSchema.description: `structuredContent` of `get_context`: the pack, section by section.

gaps.description: Core garment classes the wardrobe owns none of
gaps.title: Gaps

getting_started.description: Set when the wardrobe is empty or nearly empty: what to tell the person and how they add clothes
getting_started.title: Getting Started

profile.description: status (ready, building, not_enough_items), summary, lines [{kind, text, confirmed_by_person, garments_behind: how many of their garments support the line}], style_words, avoids
profile.title: Profile

recent.description: Latest facts (wore, liked, rejected, tried on…), each with a `subject` in words
recent.title: Recent

wants.description: What the person has saved or said they want, each described in `what`
wants.title: Wants

wardrobe.description: total, by_class, colours, materials and formality as shares, and exemplars: the most-used garments across the classes, each with the id get_item takes
wardrobe.title: Wardrobe
